04 / Home Assistant

Installation

  1. Use Home Assistant OS with Supervisor. Home Assistant Container has no app store.
  2. Open Settings → Apps → App store → ⋮ → Repositories.
  3. Add the GitHub repository below.
  4. Find Home Invest, install it and start the app. The first build can take a while.
  5. Enable Show in sidebar, open Home Invest and choose your language. Explore the demo or add a brokerage account in Settings.

https://github.com/ferrynl/ha-apps
